---
name: Something doesn't compile
about: A document that works elsewhere but not in TeXbrain
labels: compile
---

**What did you compile?**

The package or class name is the most useful thing. A minimal document that shows the problem is even better.

```latex
\documentclass{article}

\begin{document}
...
\end{document}
```

**What did TeXbrain say?**

Paste the errors tab, or the log tab, at least the lines starting with `!`.

**Browser, and how you opened the project**

Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, and whether you opened a folder or single files. Included files only reach the compiler when the whole folder is open.
